about.title: Settings

input.title: Input
input.legacyWarning: Using the Mouse & Keyboard driver together with the Gamepad keyboard mappings will cause conflicts
input.enableLegacyDescription: (Disabling this feature will disable the keyboard to gamepad mapping and only allows controls from the gamepad.)
input.controllerDetectedDescription: If you have a controller connected but it is not showing up, try to press a button on the controller to detect it.
input.keyboardMappingsDescription: These bindings are used by gamepad emulation and by the built-in keyboard-to-gamepad option. W, A, S and D always drive the left thumbstick and cannot be bound.
input.kbmDescription: Play Xbox remote play with a keyboard and mouse. Native mode sends real mouse and keyboard reports to the console and requires a game that supports keyboard & mouse on Xbox. Gamepad emulation translates the mouse into the right thumbstick and keys into controller buttons, so it works with every game.
input.kbmModeOffDescription: Keyboard and mouse input is not captured. Controller input works as usual.
input.kbmModeNativeDescription: The console receives real mouse and keyboard reports. Click the video to capture the mouse, press Esc to release it. Only games with Xbox keyboard & mouse support will respond to it.
input.kbmModeGamepadDescription: Mouse movement becomes right thumbstick movement and the key bindings below become controller buttons. Works in every game, but aiming is less precise than native input.
input.kbmToggleKeyDescription: Press this key during a stream to switch between native and gamepad emulation. Click the field and press a key to change it.
input.kbmDeadzoneDescription: Mouse movement below this threshold is ignored. Keep it at 0 for the most responsive aiming.
input.kbmCurveDescription: Lower values make small movements faster, higher values make them more precise.
input.kbmKeyboardToGamepadNote: Keys are mapped below. W, A, S and D always drive the left thumbstick.
input.kbmLegacyNote: Keyboard & mouse mode replaces the built-in input driver, so this option is ignored while a keyboard & mouse mode is active.

streaming.title: Streaming Settings
streaming.description: xHome and xCloud do not support more than 20mbps by default. This setting does not override this limit.
streaming.latencyDescription: Controls the receive-side delays between the console and this PC. Lower values feel more responsive but can stutter on a noisy network.
streaming.immediateInputDescription: Flushes mouse, keyboard and gamepad packets instead of waiting for the 16 ms input batch. Requires keyboard & mouse mode for mouse/keyboard input.
streaming.directLanDescription: Only gather local ICE candidates. Use this when the PC and console are on the same network. Remote play over the internet will not connect with this enabled.

videoAudio.title: Video
videoAudio.forceLowResDescription: (This option is useful on the Steam Deck and enables the application to render in a low resolution so FSR can be enabled.)

myConsoles.noConsoles: No consoles found on your account. If you do have an Xbox console then make sure that remote playing is enabled and that the console is visible in the official Xbox App.

streamWindow.kbmCaptureDescription: The mouse is released and the gamebar is available while the mouse is not captured.
streamWindow.kbmNativeUnsupported: This player build does not expose native mouse and keyboard frames. Gamepad emulation is used instead.
